name: Your Past
overview: Scripture calls believers to leave behind their past sins and failures, as God promises to forget transgressions and not remember sins for His own sake. Rather than dwelling on former things, Christians are urged to look forward with faith and commitment, recognizing that God’s plans for them are of peace and hope. Forgiveness is essential, both receiving from God and extending to others, as withholding forgiveness hinders one’s own forgiveness. Ultimately, God works all things together for good for those who love Him and are called according to His purpose, enabling believers to move forward without looking back.
